title.zh: Nemo 的 DSH 插件集

description.en: Nemo's DSH plugins, installed straight from GitHub and pinned per commit.
description.zh: Nemo 个人维护的 DSH 插件，直接从 GitHub 安装，按 commit 精确定位版本。

description.en: Export an installed plugin bundle as one shareable .tgz, with the install instructions copied for you.
description.zh: 把已安装的插件打包成一个可直接分享、可直接安装的 .tgz，并自动复制安装说明。

description.en: Lift pinned sessions into a Pinned section at the very top of the sidebar, plus one-click archive for a whole workspace row.
description.zh: 把置顶会话收拢到侧边栏最上方的「置顶」分区，并可一键归档某个工作区的全部会话。

description.en: macOS desktop notification when an agent turn finishes, fails or is interrupted, and when the agent waits for your answer.
description.zh: 任务跑完、出错或被打断，或者智能体停下来等你回答或审批时，弹一条 macOS 电脑通知。

description.en: OpenCode Go quota in the sidebar foot: the badge previews the rolling (5h) window's remaining percentage and reset time; open it for the 5h, weekly and monthly windows with usage and reset times.
description.zh: 在页面左下角显示 OpenCode Go 订阅额度：徽章预览滚动（5 小时）窗口的剩余百分比和刷新时间，点开查看 5 小时、每周、每月三个窗口的用量与重置时间。

description.en: Estimates the model spend of the current Session using DeepSeek's published pricing: peak/off-peak and cached/uncached input are priced separately, with per-turn and cumulative amounts.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 计费标准估算当前会话的模型调用花费：输入/输出、缓存命中/未命中、高峰/空闲分别计价，输入框下方显示累计、每条回复底部显示本轮金额。
